names: Tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
display_name: E472d (Tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.uses: EU permissions include bread prepared solely with the following ingredients: wheat flour, water, yeast or leaven,  salt. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: A mixture of glycerol esters containing tartaric acid and fatty acids from food fats or oils. The specification does not establish a single animal or plant source for the fatty-acid component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.overview: Tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
